scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: Four years ago skydiving in Thailand. My right leg broke two bones. Returned to Taiwan for emergency surgery. Had steel nails and steel plates put in.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Needed care for three months. For four years, there has always been fear of skydiving in my heart.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: After 1,286 days, I have returned to the same spot. The first jump back into the sky, heart trembling, unable to forget the unease. This time there is only one goal: where you fall, you stand back up.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: Someone asked me: 'Brother Tai Xin, aren't you afraid of heights?' I'm scared to death, every jump is scary.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: But once you cross that hurdle, life can become clear. God will keep giving you fear until you learn to face it.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: I have a very big realization. Not taking risks is the greatest risk in life.
